day-pass.name: Day Pass
day-pass.description: Open floor access for one training day.
day-pass.details: Train until close on the open floor — racks, platforms, cardio, and locker access included. Towels at the desk. Peak hours fill fast, so arrive early if you want a platform. Valid for the calendar day you check in.

personal-training.name: Personal Training
personal-training.details: Sixty minutes one-to-one with a coach: warm-up, strength or conditioning block, and a cooldown. Programming is built around your goal — strength, fat loss, or return-to-training. Book at the desk or with your coach. Cancel at least 12 hours ahead.

group-class.name: Group Class
group-class.description: Coach-led session on the class timetable.
group-class.details: A coached group session from the weekly timetable — strength, cycle, combat, or conditioning. Arrive 10 minutes early for setup. Drop-in is one class; members book in the app. Bring water and indoor shoes.

recovery-session.name: Recovery Session
recovery-session.description: Stretch, mobility, and recovery suite time.
recovery-session.details: Guided mobility plus time in the recovery suite: stretch, breath work, and soft-tissue tools. Best the day after heavy lifting or a long class block. Sessions last about 45 minutes. Ask the floor coach if you are new to the suite.

nutrition-consult.name: Nutrition Consult
nutrition-consult.description: A focused plan for fueling your training.
nutrition-consult.details: A 45-minute consult covering how you eat around training: protein targets, meal timing, and a simple weekly plan. Bring a typical food log if you have one. Follow-ups can be booked separately once the first plan is in place.

progressive-overload-without-burnout.title: Progressive Overload Without Burnout
progressive-overload-without-burnout.excerpt: How to add load week after week while protecting joints, sleep, and long-term progress.
progressive-overload-without-burnout.content:
Progressive overload is the engine of strength—but only when recovery keeps pace.

Start by tracking one primary lift per session. Add the smallest useful increment when form stays clean for all working sets. If bar speed slows dramatically or joints ache the next morning, hold load and chase better reps instead.

Deload every 4–6 weeks: cut volume by ~40% while keeping intensity familiar. Pair this with sleep targets and protein consistency. The goal is not endless escalation—it is sustainable capacity.

Forge tip: film your last working set. Visual feedback catches technical drift before injury does.

hiit-that-actually-transfers.title: HIIT That Actually Transfers
hiit-that-actually-transfers.excerpt: Not all intervals are equal. Build conditioning that supports your sport and lifts.
hiit-that-actually-transfers.content:
Random burpee circuits are not a conditioning plan.

Effective HIIT matches work:rest to the energy system you want. For strength athletes, shorter sprints with longer recovery preserve power. For fat loss phases, slightly longer work intervals with moderate rest raise average heart rate without wrecking the next squat day.

Keep sessions under 30 minutes of hard work. Warm up thoroughly. Cool down with nasal breathing. Track RPE—not just calories.

Forge tip: place HIIT after skill work, never before a heavy lower-body day.

mobility-is-not-optional.title: Mobility Is Not Optional
mobility-is-not-optional.excerpt: Range you own is range you can load. A practical weekly mobility template.
mobility-is-not-optional.content:
Mobility work is training, not a soft add-on.

Spend 10 minutes before lifting on joints you load that day. Hips and ankles before squats. Thoracic rotation before pressing. After training, use longer holds and soft tissue for tissues that felt sticky.

Consistency beats marathon stretch sessions. Three short sessions weekly outperform one hour on Sunday.

Forge tip: test a position, train it, retest. If nothing changes, change the drill—not just the duration.

f1.q: Do I need experience to join Forge?
f1.a: No. We coach beginners through advanced athletes. Your first session includes an orientation so you know the floor, safety standards, and how to book trainers.

f2.a: Pick a trainer, choose a session type, select an open slot, and confirm. You can manage bookings from your dashboard. Trainers can confirm or decline pending requests.

f3.a: Yes. Forge and Elite plans include one freeze period of up to 30 days per year. Contact us at least 5 days before the freeze start date.

f4.q: What should I bring to my first visit?
f4.a: Training shoes, a water bottle, and clothes you can move in. Towels and day lockers are available on-site. We recommend arriving 15 minutes early.

f5.q: Are the saloons included in all plans?
f5.a: Strength Floor access is included in every plan. Cycle Studio, Recovery Suite, and Combat Bay access vary by membership tier—see Pricing for details.

f6.a: Validated underground parking is available for members during training hours. Street parking and bike racks are nearby.

privacy.title: Gizlilik politikası
privacy.content:
{name} gizliliğinize saygı duyar. Bu demo sitesi hesap ve rezervasyon verilerini yalnızca gösterim amaçlı olarak tarayıcınızda yerel olarak saklar.

Bu yalnızca frontend yapıda kişisel bilgileri bir üretim sunucusuna iletmiyoruz. Canlı bir dağıtımda veri sorumlularını, saklama sürelerini, çerez kullanımını ve geçerli gizlilik yasası altındaki haklarınızı özetlerdik.

Gizlilik soruları için hello@forgeathletics.com ile iletişime geçin.

terms.title: Hizmet şartları
terms.content:
{name} dijital hizmetlerini kullanarak sorumlu antrenman yapmayı ve tesis kurallarına uymayı kabul edersiniz.

Üyelikler devredilemez. Rezervasyonlar ödeme sırasında gösterilen politikaya göre iptal edilebilir. Antrenman doğası gereği risk taşır—yeni bir programa başlamadan önce bir hekime danışın.

Bu frontend demo sunum amaçlıdır ve bağlayıcı bir ticari sözleşme oluşturmaz.

amenities.title: Olanaklar
amenities.content:
{name} tam güç salonu, bisiklet stüdyosu, dövüş alanı ve toparlanma süiti içerir.

Günlük dolaplar, duşlar, filtreli su ve havlu hizmeti mevcuttur. {shortName} ve Elite planlarındaki üyeler toparlanma süiti erişimi ve öncelikli ders rezervasyonu alır.

Wifi lounge ve toparlanma alanlarını kapsar. Misafir geçişleri üyelik kademenize bağlıdır.

tm1.quote: The coaching is sharp and the halls feel purpose-built. I finally have a program that sticks.

tm2.quote: Booking Maya was seamless. Progressive overload without ego lifting—exactly what I needed.

tm3.quote: Cycle studio nights hit different. Atmosphere is dark, loud, and focused—in the best way.

tm4.quote: Recovery suite after heavy days changed my consistency. Forge treats training like a craft.
